test_title: PYST 13: RRB Group D Official Paper GS - (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which incident was responsible for the beginning of the Chipko Movement in the village of Reni?

options.text: Sale of forest by local residents
Approval given to a contractor to fell trees near the village
Government decision to use forest land for farming

solution: The correct answer is __**Approval given to a contractor to fell trees near the village**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Chipko Movement**, a historic environmental movement in India, began in the **village of Reni** in the Garhwal Himalayas of **Uttarakhand** in **1973**. • The movement was triggered when the government approved a **contract to a sports goods company** to fell trees in the forests near the village of Reni. • When the men of the village were away, the **women of Reni**, led by **Gaura Devi**, organized themselves to protect the trees by physically hugging them, preventing the contractors from cutting them down. • This act of hugging the trees, symbolizing a non-violent protest, drew significant attention to the environmental degradation caused by deforestation and highlighted the need for sustainable forest management. • The Chipko Movement is considered one of the earliest and most successful environmental movements in India and inspired similar movements across the country.
